verdict.rationale: The only scale evidence is a marketing claim of powering "thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute" (bolna-docs-22) and a self-hosting option via Docker/Kubernetes described as "scalable" (bolna-docs-9), which gives a capacity path that does not depend on the vendor. Nothing in the pack documents actual concurrency limits or how to raise them. missing for 10: documented per-account concurrency limits, self-serve limit increases or autoscaling on the hosted platform, rate-limit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of high-concurrency performance.
